text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having once worried that she lacked the 
"glamour" of everyone else, Kitasan Black 
enters the Takarazuka Kinen as the 
fan-vote number one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle against Brusque Man 
has finally arrived. There is no need to 
chase after another's talent. What matters 
is maximizing her own potential and 
putting it all on the line.
